ai.title: Fix researcher websearch args key
ai.summary: Researcher agent templates updated in .agents/researcher.ts and backend/src/templates/agents/researcher.ts. The web_search tool call now passes prompt as query key instead of prompt key. This aligns the agent config with the expected web_search tool argument schema.

eli5.text: The researcher assistant had a small mistake in how it asked the search engine for information. It was sending its question using the wrong label that the search tool didn't recognize, so searches likely failed or returned nothing useful. The fix corrects that label so the assistant can properly ask follow-up questions and get results. This is now live and affects anyone using the researcher assistant.

ai.title: Always throw AI SDK errors in prod
ai.summary: AI SDK stream errors now throw unconditionally in `backend/src/llm-apis/vercel-ai-sdk/ai-sdk.ts`, removing the `NEXT_PUBLIC_CB_ENVIRONMENT !== 'prod'` guard. Previously, prod silently swallowed errors; now they surface as thrown exceptions with model context and response bodies. Scope is limited to the Vercel AI SDK backend adapter. The reasoning-end yield also drops `endsAgentStepParam` injection, emitting only the closing brace and tool tag.

eli5.text: When you're using the assistant on a live production system and something goes wrong with the AI response, the system used to quietly hide the error as if nothing happened. Now, in production, those errors will be raised loudly instead of being silently ignored, so problems show up where they can be seen and fixed rather than failing silently behind the scenes. This means you'll get clearer signals when the AI backend has trouble responding, especially for developers or support staff monitoring the system, since error details including the model name and response body are now passed along instead of being suppressed.

ai.title: Fix <|endoftext|> literal in logitBias JSDoc
ai.summary: Replaced the raw `<|endoftext|>` string in the `logitBias` JSDoc comment with `<|{'endoftext'}|>` in `packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk/types/openrouter-chat-settings.ts`. This change prevents potential parsing issues or unintended token interpretation when the documentation is processed. The modification is strictly internal, affecting only type definition comments within the OpenRouter AI SDK package.

eli5.text: The internal documentation that describes how the assistant controls which words get generated had a small formatting fix to keep it from being read as an actual instruction instead of just descriptive text. This affects only the behind-the-scenes definitions that the assistant's tools rely on, not anything you see or interact with. You would not notice anything different; it is purely housekeeping to keep the setup from misreading itself.

ai.title: Rename internal agent identifiers to kebab-case
ai.summary: Internal agent identifiers `file_picker` and `file_explorer` renamed to `file-picker` and `file-explorer` across types, configs, and CLI docs. Aligns subagent naming convention with kebab-case standard. Affects `.agents/`, `backend/src/`, `common/src/`, and `npm-app/src/` definitions.

eli5.text: You can now tell me to use the file picker and file explorer assistants by spelling their names with hyphens, like "file-picker" and "file-explorer", instead of underscores. Previously the system expected underscores in those two names, so using the hyphen version could cause commands to be ignored. The change updates the names everywhere they are referenced, including the list of assistants you can summon and the command-line instructions, so the hyphenated spelling now works consistently. It is a minor rename and is live today.

ai.title: Rename PrintModeObject to PrintModeEvent
ai.summary: Renamed `PrintModeObject` type and `printModeObjectSchema` to `PrintModeEvent` and `printModeEventSchema` across backend, common, and SDK packages. Updated `onResponseChunk` callbacks in `run-agent-step.ts`, `spawn-agents.ts`, and `client.ts` to use the new type. Adjusted `AgentTemplateType` definition in `session-state.ts` to use `(string & {})` for better type inference.

eli5.text: The system renamed an internal label that describes the kind of progress update your assistant sends back while it's working, so that developers see a clearer, more consistent name in the code. If you watched the assistant respond in real time (like a streamed word-by-word reply), nothing about what you see changes, the message format and timing stay the same. The update also tightened up how agent templates are recognized, which mainly affects reliability behind the scenes. It's live today as a housekeeping cleanup, not a new visible feature.

ai.title: SDK: CODEBUFFBINARY moved to constants.ts
ai.summary: CODEBUFF_BINARY constant relocated to sdk/src/constants.ts from sdk/src/client.ts and sdk/src/process-stream.ts. Eliminates duplicate declarations across SDK modules. Affects only internal SDK package structure. Import paths updated in client.ts and process-stream.ts to reference shared constant.

eli5.text: The SDK stopped repeating itself by storing its internal binary name in one shared spot instead of pasting the same value into two separate files. You won't notice anything different unless you're maintaining the SDK itself; the change only tidies up how the code is organized behind the scenes.

ai.title: Replace Claude Opus 4 with Opus 4.1
ai.summary: Model constant `anthropic/claude-4-opus-20250522` replaced with `anthropic/claude-opus-4.1` in `common/src/constants.ts` and `openrouterModels`. Type definitions in `agent-config.d.ts` updated to reflect the new model name. CLI greeting logic in `npm-app/src/menu.ts` removed obsolete 'Max mode' text block referencing the old model.

eli5.text: The most advanced assistant option now runs on a newer version of its underlying AI model, so anyone using the top-tier paid service gets access to the latest improvements from Anthropic. Behind the scenes, the system was updated to reference the new model name instead of the older one. If you use the premium assistant, your experience benefits immediately from whatever upgrades come with the new model version, and the welcome message that used to remind you about the old model has been removed.

eli5.text: This change is purely housekeeping inside the internal testing tools. A name used by the team's automated evaluation scripts was changed from PrintModeObject to PrintModeEvent in one file. It only affects engineers maintaining those scripts; you won't notice anything different in your experience today.

ai.title: CODEBUFFAPIKEY env var support
ai.summary: Core constants export API_KEY_ENV_VAR to allow CODEBUFF_API_KEY bypass login. Client and SDK use process.env check before user token. Covers common/src/constants.ts, npm-app/src/client.ts, sdk/src/client.ts. Env var takes precedence over interactive auth.

eli5.text: You can now skip logging in by setting a secret code called CODEBUFF_API_KEY in your computer's environment, and both the command-line tool and the developer kit will use that code first before asking you to log in normally. If you connect through a partner like Codebuff, your existing login still works, but the environment code takes priority when present. This is already live in the command-line tool today, though nothing in the kit reads that constant yet, so the kit change only lines up the code to match.

ai.title: SDK: require prompt in print mode
ai.summary: SDK `runNewChat` and `continueChat` now take `prompt` and `params` directly instead of an `input` object. `InputType` removed from `sdk/src/types.ts`. CLI error message updated to reflect mandatory prompt requirement. Breaks existing SDK consumers passing `input: { prompt, params }`.

eli5.text: If you invoke the assistant from another program using the SDK, you now pass the text prompt and settings as two separate top-level arguments, not wrapped inside an 'input' envelope. Existing integrations that send input={prompt,params} will fail until updated to the new call signature. The printed error when print mode is used without a prompt now reads 'Print mode requires a prompt to be set' instead of mentioning params as an alternative.

entries.title: only allow api key through env

ai.title: SDK CodebuffClient apiKey removed
ai.summary: CodebuffClient constructor drops `apiKey` option. API key resolution now exclusively via `process.env[API_KEY_ENV_VAR]`. `processStream` no longer accepts `authToken`. `CodebuffClientOptions` type updated in `sdk/src/types.ts`. `sdk/src/client.ts` and `sdk/src/process-stream.ts` reflect this change.

eli5.text: The assistant can no longer accept your API key when you create it directly; it now only looks for your key in your system's environment variable. This affects anyone using the SDK who previously passed their key as an option, because that path has been removed. If you tried to set it that way, you would now get an error telling you to set the environment variable instead.

ai.title: Add getErrorObject util
ai.summary: New getErrorObject function in common/src/util/error.ts extracts message, stack, and name from error objects. Provides standardized error serialization for shared core utilities.

eli5.text: The product can now capture a more complete and consistent snapshot of any error that occurs internally, so when something goes wrong the system records the error's message, the detailed step-by-step trace of where it happened, and the type of error it was. This behind-the-scenes addition affects how errors are collected and stored for troubleshooting, not anything you see directly. It's in place today as a building block for more reliable error reporting.

ai.title: Fix ToolCall type for agent-config
ai.summary: ToolCall type in agent-config.d.ts changed from interface to mapped type. This ensures strict association between toolName and args in handleSteps generator. Affects .agents/types and common/src/util/types. file-picker.ts updated to handle potential undefined prompt.

eli5.text: The assistant can now correctly match each requested action with the right set of information it expects, so steps that involve calling tools no longer mix up which data belongs to which action. This affects the automated helpers that are configured to guide the assistant through multi-step tasks. If you looked at what the assistant reports back while following those configured steps, you'd see tool requests and their inputs stay properly paired instead of occasionally drifting into a mismatch.

ai.title: Rename sonnet4agentbuilder to agentbuilder
ai.summary: Renamed `sonnet4_agent_builder` to `agent_builder` in `AGENT_PERSONAS`. Updated `common/src/constants/agents.ts` and all consumer files in `backend/src/templates/agents/` (ask, base, file-picker, planner, researcher, reviewer, superagent, thinker, thinking-base) to use the new key. Changed `AGENT_PERSONAS` type constraint from `Record<string, ...>` to `Partial<Record<keyof typeof AgentTemplateTypes, ...>>` for stricter typing.

eli5.text: The system renamed an internal helper for one of its built-in assistants from a longer name to a shorter, easier-to-read name. If you were looking at how the assistants are set up, you would see the labels and prompts for assistants like the planner, researcher, and reviewer now come from a source that uses cleaner names behind the scenes. The way each assistant behaves, what you see when you use it, and what data it accepts did not change. This is live today, but only someone reading the setup code would notice the difference.

ai.title: Fix import path in dynamic-agent-template-schema.test.ts
ai.summary: Corrected import path for `AgentTemplateTypes` in `common/src/__tests__/dynamic-agent-template-schema.test.ts`. Changed from absolute path `src/types/session-state` to relative path `../types/session-state`. Fixes typecheck errors in the shared core test suite.

eli5.text: A behind-the-scenes test file that checks part of the assistant system had a wrong reference to find a needed definition. Fixing that reference path means the automated checks now run without throwing errors, so the shared core test suite stays green. If you looked, you'd see one line swapped from an absolute address to a relative one, leaving everything else untouched. Nothing you see as a user changes; this is housekeeping that keeps the system's self-checks reliable today.

ai.title: Fix relative import in agents.ts
ai.summary: Corrected the `AgentTemplateTypes` import in `common/src/constants/agents.ts` from `src/types/session-state` to `../types/session-state`. This fixes module resolution failures when building or running tests that depend on this constants file.

eli5.text: The software now correctly locates one of its internal definition files, so the parts that depend on it no longer fail during startup or testing. This is a behind-the-scenes fix that developers will notice as fewer build or test errors, but you would not see any change in how the tool works.
